This project is a work in progress - resurrecting the F3 programming language.

Lazy and reactive self-adjusting computation with mutation

Support for generics including type constructors

Syntax - eschew punctuation in favor of natural language (english) function words where possible

{{{
function of (A, B, C) curry(f is function from (A, B) to C) returns function from A to (function from B to C)
{
    function(a is A) returns function from B to C
    {
        function(b is B) returns C
        {
            f(a, b)
        }
    }
}

function of (A, B, C) uncurry(f is function from A to (function from B to C)) returns function from (A, B) to C
{
    function(a is A, b is B): C
    {
        f(a)(b)
    }
}
}}}

Monad Comprehensions
{{{

// Lazy infinite streams

public class Stream of A extends Comonad of A, Monad of A {

    public val protected var first is A;
    public val protected var secondThruLast is Stream of A;

    // zip lifts a binary operator to one over Streams
    public function of (B, C) 
	zip(binOp is function from (A, B) to C, 
	    bs is Stream of B) returns Stream of C
    {
	Stream of C
	{
	    first: bind binOp(first, bs.first);
	    secondThruLast: bind secondThruLast.zip(binOp, bs.secondThruLast);
	}
    }

    // map lifts a unary operator to one over Streams
    override public function of B 
	map(unaryOp is function from A to B) returns Stream of B
    {
	Stream of B
	{
	    first: bind unaryOp(this.first);
	    secondThruLast: bind this.secondThruLast.map(unaryOp);
	}
    }

    // flatmap = join . map
    override public function of X 
	flatmap(unaryOp is function from A to Stream of X) returns Stream of X
    {
        val d = bound function(a is A) returns X { (unaryOp(a) as Stream of X).first }
        var h = bind d(first);
        var t = bind for (a in secondThruLast) d(a);
        Stream of X {
            first: bind h;
            secondThruLast: bind t;
        }
    }

    // map lifts a unary operator to one over Streams
    override function of B 
	coflatmap(unaryOp is function from Stream of A to B) returns Stream of B
    {
	Stream of B
	{
	    first: bind unaryOp(this);
	    secondThruLast: bind secondThruLast.coflatmap(unaryOp);
	}
    }

    override public function extract() returns A { first }

    public bound function fby(s is Stream of A) returns Stream of A 
    {
	Stream of A {
	    first: bind first;
	    secondThruLast: bind s; 
	}
    }
}

// lifts a constant to a Stream i.e,  t, t, t, ...
public function of T toStream(t is T) returns Stream of T
{
    Stream of T {
        first: t;
        override var secondThruLast = this;
    }
}


// creates an infinite stream of 3s
let zs = bind for (xs in toStream(1.0), ys in toStream(2.0)) { x + y }

}}}
